==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League BroodWar Season 3''' or '''AfreecaTV StarLeague Season 3''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].

The Starleague features 2 qualifiers scheduled for Seoul and Busan on April 1 and 2, 2017, respectively<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/brood-war/520293-asl-s3-offline-qualifiers ASL3 qualifiers]</ref>.

Round of 24 play will begin on Tuesday April 11, 2017 and league play will be broadcasted every Sunday and Tuesday 19:00 {{Abbr/KST}}.

The grand final of the tournament will be held at Seoul Children's Grand Park<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/brood-war/466030-afreeca-feed?page=94#1875 ASL Season 3 Finals venue announced]</ref><br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zI9-DqINqRo</embedvideo>

===Format===
<!--
;Preliminary Qualifiers
*14 groups of 32-128 players each, seven groups in each of Seoul and Busan
*Single-elimination bracket: best-of-three
*Winner of each group advances
-->
;Round of 24 group stage
*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
*Top two players in each group advance

;Round of 16 group stage
* 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[2016-2017 AfreecaTV StarCraft League BroodWar Season 2|ASL Season 2]]
*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
*Top two players in each group advance

;Elimination Stage
*Eight player single-elimination bracket
*Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
